glossZh: 滥用，误用；（名词）恶习，弊端
glossEn: use wrongly or improperly or excessively
note: use wrongly or improperly or excessively。线索：abuse power / drug abuse / abuse of。宾语决定是哪种「滥用」。
[glossEn 空：ECDICT 与 WordNet 均无对应义位] [ZH-FALLBACK 英文零覆盖] 英文 abuse（粗暴对待）。ECDICT definition 侧无边界，走 fromZh 补洞，glossEn 留空。线索：child / domestic + abuse。名词 abuse 指「虐待行为」时也走这条。

glossEn: a rude expression intended to offend or hurt / use foul or abusive language towards
note: a rude expression intended to offend or hurt / use foul or abusive language towards。名词与动词两面合并。线索：a term of abuse / abuse sb verbally。注意与 s1 分界：宾语是「权力/药物」还是「人」。
